details.biography: Phoebe Robinson-Galvin is an actress and action performer raised in London, England. Her major achievements involve work on 'Hanna' (2020), 'Wonder Woman' (2017), and 'Justice League' (2017). She has recently been cast as Kate Lynch along with Vinnie Jones and Stu Bennett in the upcoming Ross Boyask action film 'I am Vengeance Retaliation' (2020).
